title: Supermarket announcement
instructions: Süpermarkette kısa bir anons. Kısa ama her bilgi önemli. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Today all fruit is half price, but not bananas.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The café on the first floor is closed today.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The supermarket closes at nine tonight, not ten.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Thank you for shopping with us.
